event: Singapore's independence. Life expectancy ~65 years. Infectious diseases dominant.
Singapore General Hospital opens its new campus.
Medisave launched — compulsory medical savings scheme.
First National Health Survey conducted — baseline chronic disease data established. Diabetes at 7.3%, daily smoking at 18.3%.
WHO ranks Singapore 6th globally for health systems.
Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP) launched for diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidaemia.
National Health Survey reveals diabetes at 8.6% and obesity at 10.8% — both significant increases from earlier surveys.
PM Lee declares 'War on Diabetes' at National Day Rally.
Singapore achieves among world's highest life expectancy at 83.6 years.
COVID-19 pandemic. Life expectancy dips to 83.0. Health expenditure surges to $13.9B.
Healthier SG White Paper published — shift towards preventive care and enrolment with family doctors. Hypertension at 37% under new methodology.
Healthier SG programme officially launches. Screen for Life enhanced. Daily smoking drops to historic low of 8.8%.
